test.query: SELECT timeSeriesRemoveTag( timeSeriesTagsToGroup( [('__name__', 'metric'), ('namespace', toString(number % 100)), ('pod', toString(number))]), '__name__') FROM numbers(500000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null

SELECT timeSeriesRemoveAllTagsExcept( timeSeriesTagsToGroup( [('__name__', 'metric'), ('namespace', toString(number % 100)), ('pod', toString(number % 10000))]), ['namespace']) FROM numbers(500000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null

WITH ( SELECT groupArray(group) FROM ( SELECT number, timeSeriesTagsToGroup([('shared', 'value'), ('unique', toString(number))]) AS group FROM numbers(262144) ORDER BY number ) ) AS groups SELECT timeSeriesRemoveAllTagsExcept(groups[if(number % 2 = 0, 1, 262144)], ['shared']) FROM numbers(65536) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 65536 FORMAT Null
